property.name: CanDeserializeIntoExistingObject
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether this component may load data into an existing object or if it must it construct a new instance of the object before loading the data.

property.name: TargetType
property.summary: Gets the type handled by this serializer component.

property.name: XmlTypeName
property.summary: Gets a short-form XML name for the target type, or null if there is none.
